schema_note: LSD (log-spectral distance) metrics are in dB and lower is better; speaker_cosine_sim is higher is better. speaker_cosine_sim is computed by the in-repo deterministic mel-DSP SpeakerEmbeddingExtractor, not a neural speaker verification model. Test signals are the 10 synthetic canonical profile WAVs that the personalized model also conditions on (non-holdout).
